cues.text: Mist drifts through a lush forest of massive trees. A tall bird with sweeping crest feathers stands motionless.
A brilliant streak of light descends through the hazy canopy.
The bird turns its head to watch the landing craft fall. Glowing motes float gently in the damp air as the ship vanishes behind the distant trees.

beats.note: A lush green forest with massive tree trunks rising into the background mist. A tall bird with a long beak and sweeping crest feathers stands motionless in the foreground.
A bright streak of light falls from the sky on the right, cutting through the mist.
The bird turns its head slightly to watch the falling light.
The light disappears behind the distant trees. Small glowing motes float gently in the damp air.
